purpose: Qualify source plus two frozen-Bernini appearance variants as same-motion, different-identity pretext data; never as action-edit supervision.

member_gates.appearance_identity_changed_from_source: The edited actor has a stable, visibly different identity/appearance from frame 0 through frame 80; a mid-video identity transition fails.
member_gates.motion_phase_and_order_preserved: Actor pose, articulated motion phases, direction, object interaction, and coarse timing correspond to the source; pixel equality is not required.
member_gates.camera_path_preserved: Framing, viewpoint, and any camera motion correspond to the source across the full clip.
member_gates.background_scene_preserved: Scene layout, lighting family, and background content remain source-corresponding.
member_gates.object_correspondence_preserved: Every action-relevant source object remains present with corresponding position and temporal role.
member_gates.temporal_quality_passed: No identity morph, subject duplication, temporal discontinuity, or progressive collapse is visible.
member_gates.spatial_quality_passed: No severe anatomical, texture, or compositing failure makes the member unusable as a visual condition.
member_gates.no_extra_actor_or_object: No actor or action-relevant object is added or removed.

cross_member_gates.variant_a_and_variant_b_semantic_identit: The two variants are semantically distinct identities/appearances, not merely byte-distinct encodes or tiny color jitter.
cross_member_gates.same_motion_across_all_members: All three members retain corresponding ordered motion phases and interaction structure.
cross_member_gates.same_camera_across_all_members: All three members retain the same camera path and framing.
cross_member_gates.same_scene_across_all_members: All three members retain the same scene and action-relevant objects.

decision_rule: Every member and cross-member gate must pass; no weighted compensation and no post-training reselection are allowed.
forbidden_claims: independent human evaluation unless a human actually signs a separate seal
